messages:
incident-bot: INCIDENT: metering anomaly — token_count drift observed from emitter-service. Several overage flags triggered (3 customers). Paging @ops_oncall.

ops_oncall: taking this. setting incident->investigating. assigning P2 for now.

ops_oncall: quick ask — any visibility on deploys in last 30m?

dana: saw a small deploy at ~01:12 UTC to emitter-proxy v2.0. Query shows sudden jump in emitted token_count for many keys:
```sql
SELECT hour, sum(tokens) FROM tokens_emitted WHERE ts >= now() - interval '1 hour' GROUP BY hour ORDER BY hour DESC LIMIT 6;
-- results: 01:00: 120k, 01:10: 118k, 01:12: 1.4M, 01:15: 130k
```

leo: billing note: customers cust_41, cust_73, cust_88 got automated overage flags and started charge pipeline. Pausing alerts and charge capture recommended until we confirm root cause.

ops_oncall: agreed — pausing auto-overage alerts now.
/mgmt pause-alerts --filter tag:auto-overage --until 1754324600

maria: rolling back emitter-proxy to v1.5 now (kubectl rollout undo). ETA ~2m.
```bash
kubectl -n prod rollout undo deployment/emitter-proxy --to-revision=15
```

dana: grabbing logs around 01:12 — lots of duplicate emit lines, looks like a duplicative loop from emitter v2: sample:
```
[2025-10-12T01:12:03Z] emitter INFO token_count=4500 request_id=abc123
[2025-10-12T01:12:03Z] emitter INFO token_count=4500 request_id=abc123
[2025-10-12T01:12:03Z] emitter INFO token_count=4500 request_id=abc123
```

ops_oncall: rollback initiated. starting backfill/replay job to de-dupe and correct counts: job run usage-replay --from 2025-10-12T01:10Z --to 2025-10-12T01:20Z

leo: I'll open a manual hold on invoices for the affected customers and draft credit memos pending reconciliation. Please tag final corrected counts to ticket BILL-4123.

support_lead: pinging CSMs + support triage. Drafting customer-safe message: "We detected an internal metering issue causing temporary incorrect usage notifications. No charges will be applied while we reconcile. We'll follow up with corrected usage and any credits." :thumbsup:

incident-bot: update: rollback completed, emitter-proxy -> v1.5. Alerts paused. Backfill job started (job_id=0xefd3). Severity remains P2; customer-visible overage notifications suppressed.

maria: rollback confirmed healthy. metrics: emitter_emits_total back to baseline: 140k/min -> 132k/min; duplicate emit rate dropped ~98%.

dana: backfill in progress. sample check after initial run:
```sql
-- post-replay quick check
SELECT customer_id, sum(tokens) FROM tokens_canonical WHERE ts >= '2025-10-12T01:00:00Z' AND ts < '2025-10-12T01:30:00Z' GROUP BY customer_id ORDER BY sum DESC LIMIT 5;
-- cust_41: 12,340 (corrected), cust_73: 9,100 (corrected)
```

ops_oncall: handing off to night oncall @mika. Summary: rollback completed, alerts paused, backfill job 0xefd3 running, billing hold placed on flagged customers, CSMs notified. Next steps for oncall: monitor backfill progress, verify final reconciled counts, coordinate with leo for credits, and reopen alerts only after sign-off.

mika: ack — taking over. I'll watch the backfill job and confirm reconciliation + closure. Report back when counts stable or if any re-flagging occurs.
